profile.headline: Software Developer at Simple Higher Ed
profile.summary: I’m a full-stack developer with experience building applications using TypeScript, Node.js, Angular, and PostgreSQL. I also have hands-on experience working with AWS services and have successfully designed, deployed, and managed production-grade application infrastructure in the cloud.
